+"""Kernel-level IR for hardware acceleration in K-CIRCT."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Any, Tuple
+from enum import Enum
+
+
+class ScheduleConstraint(Enum):
+    ASAP = "as_soon_as_possible"
+    ALAP = "as_late_as_possible"
+    FIXED = "fixed_cycle"
+    RELATIVE = "relative_offset"
+
+
+class ResourceType(Enum):
+    ALU = "alu"
+    MULTIPLIER = "multiplier"
+    MEMORY_PORT = "memory_port"
+    DSP = "dsp"
+    BRAM = "bram"
+    REGISTER = "register"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class LatencyModel:
+    """Models operation latency for scheduling."""
+    operation_latencies: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    default_latency: int = 1
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.operation_latencies:
+            self.operation_latencies = {
+                "add": 1, "sub": 1, "mul": 3, "div": 10,
+                "load": 2, "store": 1, "cmp": 1, "mux": 0,
+                "shift": 1, "and": 1, "or": 1, "xor": 1,
+            }
+
+    def get_latency(self, op_type: str) -> int:
+        return self.operation_latencies.get(op_type, self.default_latency)
+
+    def set_latency(self, op_type: str, cycles: int) -> None:
+        self.operation_latencies[op_type] = cycles
+
+    def total_latency(self, op_types: List[str]) -> int:
+        return sum(self.get_latency(op) for op in op_types)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ResourceBinding:
+    """Binds operations to physical hardware resources."""
+    bindings: Dict[str, Tuple[ResourceType, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    resource_limits: Dict[ResourceType, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.resource_limits:
+            self.resource_limits = {
+                ResourceType.ALU: 4,
+                ResourceType.MULTIPLIER: 2,
+                ResourceType.MEMORY_PORT: 2,
+                ResourceType.DSP: 8,
+                ResourceType.BRAM: 4,
+            }
+
+    def bind(self, op_name: str, resource: ResourceType, instance: int) -> bool:
+        limit = self.resource_limits.get(resource, 1)
+        if instance >= limit:
+            return False
+        self.bindings[op_name] = (resource, instance)
+        return True
+
+    def get_binding(self, op_name: str) -> Optional[Tuple[ResourceType, int]]:
+        return self.bindings.get(op_name)
+
+    def utilization(self, resource: ResourceType) -> float:
+        bound_count = sum(1 for r, _ in self.bindings.values() if r == resource)
+        limit = self.resource_limits.get(resource, 1)
+        return bound_count / limit if limit > 0 else 0.0
+
+    def is_available(self, resource: ResourceType, instance: int) -> bool:
+        for r, i in self.bindings.values():
+            if r == resource and i == instance:
+                return False
+        return instance < self.resource_limits.get(resource, 1)

+@dataclass
+class KernelOp:
+    """Top-level kernel operation for hardware acceleration."""
+    name: str
+    operations: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
+    inputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
+    outputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)

+
+    def critical_path_latency(self) -> int:

+        return sum(self.latency_model.get_latency(op["op_type"]) for op in self.operations)
+
+    def estimated_cycles(self) -> int:
+        if self.schedule:

+        return self.critical_path_latency()

+@dataclass
+class DataflowOp:
+    """Dataflow-level operation with token-based execution."""
+    name: str
+    op_type: str
+    input_tokens: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    output_tokens: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    latency: int = 1

+    current_stage: int = 0

+"""HW (Hardware) dialect - structural hardware constructs for CIRCT."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Tuple
+from enum import Enum
+
+
+class Direction(Enum):
+    INPUT = "in"
+    OUTPUT = "out"
+    INOUT = "inout"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class IntType:
+    """Integer type with specified bit width."""
+    width: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.width <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"IntType width must be positive, got {self.width}")
+
+    def bit_count(self) -> int:
+        return self.width
+
+    def max_value(self) -> int:
+        return (1 << self.width) - 1
+
+    def mask(self) -> int:
+        return (1 << self.width) - 1
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"i{self.width}"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ArrayType:
+    """Array type with element type and size."""
+    element_type: Any
+    size: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.size <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"ArrayType size must be positive, got {self.size}")
+
+    def bit_count(self) -> int:
+        if hasattr(self.element_type, 'bit_count'):
+            return self.element_type.bit_count() * self.size
+        return self.size
+
+    def element_at(self, index: int) -> Any:
+        if index < 0 or index >= self.size:
+            raise IndexError(f"Array index {index} out of bounds [0, {self.size})")
+        return self.element_type
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"!hw.array<{self.size}x{self.element_type}>"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class StructType:
+    """Struct type with named fields."""
+    fields: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+    def bit_count(self) -> int:
+        total: int = 0
+        for _, ftype in self.fields:
+            if hasattr(ftype, 'bit_count'):
+                total += ftype.bit_count()
+        return total
+
+    def get_field_type(self, name: str) -> Optional[Any]:
+        for fname, ftype in self.fields:
+            if fname == name:
+                return ftype
+        return None
+
+    def field_names(self) -> List[str]:
+        return [fname for fname, _ in self.fields]
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        parts = [f"{n}: {t}" for n, t in self.fields]
+        return f"!hw.struct<{', '.join(parts)}>"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class InOutType:
+    """Bidirectional type wrapper."""
+    inner_type: Any
+
+    def bit_count(self) -> int:
+        if hasattr(self.inner_type, 'bit_count'):
+            return self.inner_type.bit_count()
+        return 0
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"!hw.inout<{self.inner_type}>"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Port:
+    """Port definition with name, type, and direction."""
+    name: str
+    port_type: Any
+    direction: Direction = Direction.INPUT
+
+    @property
+    def is_input(self) -> bool:
+        return self.direction == Direction.INPUT
+
+    @property
+    def is_output(self) -> bool:
+        return self.direction == Direction.OUTPUT
+
+    @property
+    def is_inout(self) -> bool:
+        return self.direction == Direction.INOUT
+
+    def bit_width(self) -> int:
+        if hasattr(self.port_type, 'bit_count'):
+            return self.port_type.bit_count()
+        return 0
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"Port({self.direction.value} {self.name}: {self.port_type})"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class HWModuleOp:
+    """Hardware module operation - top-level structural container."""
+    name: str
+    ports: List[Port] = field(default_factory=list)
+    body: List[Any] = field(default_factory=list)
+    attributes: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    @property
+    def input_ports(self) -> List[Port]:
+        return [p for p in self.ports if p.is_input]
+
+    @property
+    def output_ports(self) -> List[Port]:
+        return [p for p in self.ports if p.is_output]
+
+    @property
+    def inout_ports(self) -> List[Port]:
+        return [p for p in self.ports if p.is_inout]
+
+    def verify_signature(self) -> List[str]:
+        errors: List[str] = []
+        seen_names: set = set()
+        for port in self.ports:
+            if port.name in seen_names:
+                errors.append(f"Duplicate port name: {port.name}")
+            seen_names.add(port.name)
+            if port.bit_width() == 0:

+

+        return sum(p.bit_width() for p in self.input_ports)
+
+    def total_output_bits(self) -> int:
+        return sum(p.bit_width() for p in self.output_ports)
+

+@dataclass
+class InstanceOp:

+    parameters: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

+        self.inputs[port_name] = value
+
+    def get_output_names(self) -> List[str]:
+        return list(self.outputs)
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"InstanceOp({self.instance_name} : {self.module_name})"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class OutputOp:
+    """Module output operation - terminates module body."""
+    operands: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+    def operand_count(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.operands)
+
+    def get_operand(self, index: int) -> str:
+        if 0 <= index < len(self.operands):
+            return self.operands[index]
+        raise IndexError(f"Operand index {index} out of range")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class WireOp:
+    """Wire declaration within a module."""
+    name: str
+    wire_type: Any = None
+    value: Optional[Any] = None
+
+    def bit_width(self) -> int:
+        if hasattr(self.wire_type, 'bit_count'):
+            return self.wire_type.bit_count()
+        return 0
+
+    def assign(self, value: Any) -> None:
+        self.value = value
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"WireOp({self.name}: {self.wire_type})"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ConstantOp:
+    """Hardware constant value."""
+    value: int
+    width: int
+    result_name: str = ""
+
+    def evaluate(self) -> int:
+        mask = (1 << self.width) - 1
+        return self.value & mask
+
+    def is_zero(self) -> bool:
+        return self.evaluate() == 0
+
+    def is_all_ones(self) -> bool:
+        return self.evaluate() == (1 << self.width) - 1
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"ConstantOp({self.value}: i{self.width})"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ArrayCreateOp:
+    """Create an array from individual elements."""
+    elements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    element_type: Any = None
+    result_name: str = ""
+
+    def size(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.elements)
+
+    def result_type(self) -> Optional[ArrayType]:
+        if self.element_type is not None:
+            return ArrayType(element_type=self.element_type, size=self.size())
+        return None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class StructCreateOp:
+    """Create a struct from named field values."""
+    field_values: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    struct_type: Optional[StructType] = None
+    result_name: str = ""
+
+    def get_field(self, name: str) -> Optional[str]:
+        return self.field_values.get(name)
+
+    def field_count(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.field_values)
